scope: Opened all five contact sheets: four textured source views, wire shader diagnostic without mesh modifiers, and clean GLB reimport for each model. Source and packaged appearance compared.
observations: All 21 native glTF sources and packed GLBs retain matching appearance, orientation, dimensions and mesh/material counts.
Six modular kits retain the full author layout, including spatially arranged pieces; source-side views can be edge-on. Use orbit/zoom for inspection; original archives preserve every component.
Chemical products are modeled containers and labels; scientific contents, regional markings, instrument accuracy and curricular use remain NOT_RUN.
Electrical generators and workshop wrenches join existing semantic families; functional variants are not treated as binary duplicates.
publicationImages: Lossless WebP; decoded RGBA pixel equality verified. Original PNG hashes retained in image-encoding.json and staging.
